Pokedex.Name: Roogby
Pokedex.DexDescription: Roogby are known as some of the most determined and loyal Pokémon in Sundor. In the wild, they are often found training to improve their skills.
Pokedex.DescIT: Determinato e leale; in natura lo si trova spesso ad allenarsi per migliorare.

Pokedex.Name: Kangrivine
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon is known for creating a game played all over Sundor. Anyone can play it, but these Pokémon are the best.
Pokedex.DescIT: Ha inventato un gioco praticato in tutta la regione: chiunque può giocarci, ma loro sono i migliori.

Pokedex.Name: Trunkscrum
Pokedex.DexDescription: Trunkscrum train their entire lives to become ultimate athletes. They practice by pummeling trees into rugby balls.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si allena tutta la vita per diventare un atleta perfetto: colpisce gli alberi fino a ridurli a palloni da rugby.

Pokedex.Name: Embala
Pokedex.DexDescription: Embala is an incredibly happy yet lazy Pokémon. They eat all sorts of food throughout the day so they can improve their defenses.
Pokedex.DescIT: Allegro ma pigro; mangia di tutto tutto il giorno per rafforzare le difese.

Pokedex.Name: Koaboom
Pokedex.DexDescription: Due to the large amount of poisonous eucalyptus this Pokémon eats, it creates an explosive reaction in its stomach.
Pokedex.DescIT: L'eucalipto velenoso che mangia provoca una reazione esplosiva nel suo stomaco.

Pokedex.Name: Euxplosion
Pokedex.DexDescription: This gentle giant can become quite ferocious if its food or friends are harmed. The food it eats causes an explosive reaction.
Pokedex.DescIT: Gigante buono, diventa feroce se toccano il suo cibo o i suoi amici; il cibo gli causa reazioni esplosive.

Pokedex.Name: Daulphin
Pokedex.DexDescription: Daulphin spend most of their time looking at their reflection in the water. They are very proud Pokémon that sometimes have a hard time listening to their trainer.
Pokedex.DescIT: Passa il tempo a specchiarsi nell'acqua; orgoglioso, a volte non ascolta l'allenatore.

Pokedex.Name: Porprince
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon can be likened to a spoiled teenager. They are awkward Pokémon who get angry if they don't get what they want.
Pokedex.DescIT: Come un adolescente viziato: goffo, si arrabbia se non ottiene quello che vuole.

Pokedex.Name: Coroyal
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon is known as the ruler of the sea. They're very haughty and will only listen to trainers they have a strong bond with.
Pokedex.DescIT: Il «sovrano del mare»; altezzoso, obbedisce solo agli allenatori con cui ha un legame forte.

Pokedex.Name: Bloomidae
Pokedex.DexDescription: In Almera it's believed if a bloomidae visits one's graden you will be blessed with a beautiful garden for year's to come.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si crede che il giardino che visita resti rigoglioso per anni.

Pokedex.Name: Comlidae
Pokedex.DexDescription: When comlidae settles in an area the plant live grows rich and lush, it also acts as a caretaker for the local wild life.
Pokedex.DescIT: Dove si stabilisce le piante crescono rigogliose; si prende cura della fauna locale.

Pokedex.Name: Nectreal
Pokedex.DexDescription: Nectreal secrete a sweet nectar from there body's that the indigenous people of almera would collect and use in many healing brews and antidotes, nectreal are also known as the healers of the Forest.
Pokedex.DescIT: Secerne un nettare usato in pozioni curative e antidoti: è il guaritore della foresta.

Pokedex.Name: Kindillo
Pokedex.DexDescription: Kindillo roll up into a ball while they sleep and there shell will give off a dim glow, from a distance they can be mistaken for a campfire.
Pokedex.DescIT: Dorme arrotolato e il guscio brilla debolmente: da lontano sembra un fuoco da campo.

Pokedex.Name: Blazedillo
Pokedex.DexDescription: It's warm body is ideal for cold Winter nights, it can be found with many pokemon huddle around it for warmth in the wild.
Pokedex.DescIT: Il suo corpo caldo attira i Pokémon selvatici, che d'inverno gli si stringono intorno.

Pokedex.Name: Armurillo
Pokedex.DexDescription: It's armor is strong enough to withstand hours of relentless attacks, it's usually seen defending smaller pokemon. It's referred to as the guardian of the plains.
Pokedex.DescIT: Corazza che regge ore di attacchi; protegge i Pokémon più piccoli. «Guardiano delle pianure».

Pokedex.Name: Ottarina
Pokedex.DexDescription: Ottarina can be found playing and swimming in most rivers across Almera, some have even seen small groups of ottarina swimming in sync.
Pokedex.DescIT: Gioca e nuota nei fiumi; a volte se ne vedono gruppetti nuotare in sincrono.

Pokedex.Name: Otturene
Pokedex.DexDescription: Otturene compete with one another to decide the alpha of the group, the winner will lead the others through various routines.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si sfidano per decidere il capo del gruppo, che poi guida gli altri nelle coreografie.

Pokedex.Name: Lomirene
Pokedex.DexDescription: Lomirene swim and dance gracefully through the water, people and pokemon alike that see this sight are captivated by the preference.
Pokedex.DescIT: Nuota e danza con grazia; chi lo vede resta incantato.

Pokedex.Name: Rombat
Pokedex.DexDescription: Rombat are extremely playful Pokémon that are found all over Sundor. They are oftentimes kept as pets.
Pokedex.DescIT: Giocosissimo e diffuso ovunque; spesso tenuto come animale domestico.

Pokedex.Name: Rockeroll
Pokedex.DexDescription: Rockeroll are extremely loud Pokémon, but are very musically talented. They can be heard for miles around.
Pokedex.DescIT: Rumorosissimo ma molto dotato per la musica; lo si sente a chilometri di distanza.

Pokedex.Name: Suglary
Pokedex.DexDescription: Suglary live in the woods and trees surrounding towns. They often help passing trainers in return for sweets.
Pokedex.DescIT: Vive nei boschi vicino ai paesi; aiuta gli allenatori di passaggio in cambio di dolci.

Pokedex.Name: Impungent
Pokedex.DexDescription: Impungent are huge tricksters that will wait for unsuspecting travelers so that they can steal their berries and food.
Pokedex.DescIT: Gran burlone: tende agguati ai viaggiatori per rubare bacche e cibo.

Pokedex.Name: Kindlet
Pokedex.DexDescription: Kindlet are often found isolated from other Pokémon. They spend their time in solitude hunting Rattata in the desert.
Pokedex.DescIT: Solitario; passa il tempo a cacciare Rattata nel deserto.

Pokedex.Name: Pyrethon
Pokedex.DexDescription: Pyrethon are one of the top predators in the desert. It takes a well-trained Pokémon to defeat one.
Pokedex.DescIT: Tra i predatori più forti del deserto; serve un Pokémon ben allenato per batterlo.

Pokedex.Name: Enkipaku
Pokedex.DexDescription: Enkipaku are sweet Pokémon that often live by themselves. They use their spines as defense mechanisms against other Pokémon.
Pokedex.DescIT: Dolce e solitario; usa gli aculei per difendersi.

Pokedex.Name: Pygmodo
Pokedex.DexDescription: Pygmodo use their long tongues as whips to spread a poison made from [parola mancante sulla scheda] this poison is highly toxic and tricky to cure.
Pokedex.DescIT: Usa la lingua come frusta per spargere un veleno molto tossico e difficile da curare.

Pokedex.Name: Garguana
Pokedex.DexDescription: Garguana spend most of their time boasting their power. They are some of the most powerful Pokémon in the desert.
Pokedex.DescIT: Passa il tempo a vantarsi della sua forza; tra i Pokémon più potenti del deserto.

Pokedex.Name: Pugglix
Pokedex.DexDescription: Pugglix are sickly Pokémon that originated on Palakana Island. They have since become an invasive species in Sundor.
Pokedex.DescIT: Malaticcio, arriva dall'isola di Palakana ed è diventato una specie invasiva.

Pokedex.Name: Pestypux
Pokedex.DexDescription: Pestypux are very loving Pokémon. Despite being very sickly, they use their power to heal any Pokémon that they can.
Pokedex.DescIT: Affettuoso: pur essendo malaticcio, usa il suo potere per curare gli altri Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Ekans (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: Due to the large competition with other snake-like Pokémon in Sundor, Ekans were forced to move to the snowy mountains.
Pokedex.DescIT: Per la concorrenza con altri serpenti si è trasferito sulle montagne innevate.

Pokedex.Name: Arbok (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: Arbok in Sundor are in a sleep like state for most of their lives. If any creature meets Arbok's gaze, they are frozen immediately.
Pokedex.DescIT: Vive quasi sempre in uno stato simile al sonno; chi incrocia il suo sguardo resta congelato.

Pokedex.Name: Tangela (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon is found washed up on the shores of Sundor. It likes to poison any beachgoers that happen to walk near it.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si trova spiaggiato sulle coste e avvelena chi gli passa vicino.

Pokedex.Name: Tangrel
Pokedex.DexDescription: Tangrel are extremely mischevious Pokémon that often harass people and other Pokémon alike.
Pokedex.DescIT: Molto dispettoso: tormenta persone e Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Lickitung (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: No one is sure how Lickitung were introduced to Sundor. Soon after, they began aggressively competing for resources.
Pokedex.DescIT: Nessuno sa come sia arrivato nella regione; compete in modo aggressivo per le risorse.

Pokedex.Name: Lickilicky (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: When it adapted to the climate, Lickilicky became an invasive species in Sundor. It threatens people and Pokémon alike.
Pokedex.DescIT: Adattatosi al clima, è diventato una specie invasiva che minaccia persone e Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Shockam
Pokedex.DexDescription: Shockam are very simple Pokémon that love to roam the expansive wild area of Sundor.
Pokedex.DescIT: Semplice; ama vagare per le vaste zone selvagge.

Pokedex.Name: Dromerator
Pokedex.DexDescription: Dromerator are very powerful Pokémon both on and off the field. They are used to power entire camps in the wild area.
Pokedex.DescIT: Potentissimo, in lotta e fuori: viene usato per dare energia a interi accampamenti.

Pokedex.Name: Cygmess
Pokedex.DexDescription: Cygmess was once an extremely beautiful Pokémon, but some ecological disaster made it look this way.
Pokedex.DescIT: Un tempo bellissimo, è diventato così per un disastro ecologico.

Pokedex.Name: Swagooze
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon viciously attacks anyone who makes fun of their appearance. They are jealous of all Pokémon that are beautiful.
Pokedex.DescIT: Attacca con ferocia chi lo prende in giro; invidia tutti i Pokémon belli.

Pokedex.Name: Foalit
Pokedex.DexDescription: These sickly Pokémon were meant to be working Pokémon like Mudbray and Mudsdale. They're too weak to do any jobs.
Pokedex.DescIT: Malaticcio; doveva essere un Pokémon da lavoro come Mudbray, ma è troppo debole.

Pokedex.Name: Burroferno
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon has become a pest and a nuisance to the region. Their mean nature scares almost every trainer away.
Pokedex.DescIT: Considerato una piaga; il suo caratteraccio spaventa quasi tutti gli allenatori.

Pokedex.Name: Lizeuna
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon is well known for two things: its own unique fighting style, and its deep-rooted rivalry with all Granbull.
Pokedex.DescIT: Famoso per il suo stile di lotta unico e per l'antica rivalità con tutti i Granbull.

Pokedex.Name: Diggid
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon is most often found looking for ores in the mines near Port Muddier.
Pokedex.DescIT: Lo si trova a cercare minerali nelle miniere.

Pokedex.Name: Magold
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon has made a fortune mining for gold, but it doesn't share the wealth with anyone, even its own family.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si è arricchito estraendo oro, ma non lo divide con nessuno, nemmeno con la famiglia.

Pokedex.Name: Toxifry
Pokedex.DexDescription: Toxifry live in large groups under the sea. They rarely come above the waves due to their timid natures.
Pokedex.DescIT: Vive in grandi gruppi sott'acqua; timido, sale raramente in superficie.

Pokedex.Name: Electring
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon has become very angsty upon evolution. They become annoyed very easily and shock people often.
Pokedex.DescIT: Evolvendosi diventa irritabile: si innervosisce facilmente e dà la scossa alle persone.

Pokedex.Name: Corrosopod
Pokedex.DexDescription: Corrosopod are known to have such strong poison that it paralyzes its opponents with just one drop.
Pokedex.DescIT: Ha un veleno così forte che una sola goccia paralizza l'avversario.

Pokedex.Name: Helioptile (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: In Sundor, Helioptile lose their frills due to the sheer amount of sun in the deserts. It absorbs through their whole body.
Pokedex.DescIT: Nel sole del deserto ha perso il collare: assorbe la luce con tutto il corpo.

Pokedex.Name: Heliolisk (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: Heliolisk have a burning passion for energy, so much so that they spend all of their time absorbing the sun's rays.
Pokedex.DescIT: Ha una passione bruciante per l'energia: passa tutto il tempo ad assorbire i raggi del sole.

Pokedex.Name: Meowth (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers to float its precious coin above its head. It's bad luck if the coin ever touches the ground.
Pokedex.DescIT: Fa levitare la sua moneta sopra la testa; porta sfortuna se tocca terra.

Pokedex.Name: Perrsona
Pokedex.DexDescription: These friendly Pokémon love to travel Sundor and give psychic readings to people and Pokémon.
Pokedex.DescIT: Amichevole; viaggia per fare letture psichiche a persone e Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Spirtina
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon is thought to be the lost souls of opera singers. They are usually found singing solemn songs.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si pensa sia l'anima perduta di cantanti d'opera; canta canzoni solenni.

Pokedex.Name: Spectezzo
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon's love for the opera has become an obsession. It likes to control and direct other Pokémon.
Pokedex.DescIT: L'amore per l'opera è diventato un'ossessione: gli piace dirigere e controllare gli altri.

Pokedex.Name: Phantaestro
Pokedex.DexDescription: Phantaestro are extremely powerful Pokémon that love to put on entire operas by themselves.
Pokedex.DescIT: Potentissimo; mette in scena opere intere da solo.

Pokedex.Name: Mantyke (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon is a nuisance to the fishermen in Sundor. If they get caught in the nets, the fishermen will get electrocuted.
Pokedex.DescIT: La piaga dei pescatori: se finisce nelle reti, li fulmina.

Pokedex.Name: Mantine (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon is seen as a bad omen by sailors leaving ports.
Pokedex.DescIT: I marinai lo considerano un cattivo presagio.

Pokedex.Name: Doduo (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: Due to the harsh environment, Doduo had to resolve to sharpening their twin minds in order to survive.
Pokedex.DescIT: Per sopravvivere all'ambiente ostile ha affinato le sue due menti.

Pokedex.Name: Dodrio (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: Dodrio's immense psychic power is concentrated in the gems on their heads, which are similar to those of Golducks.
Pokedex.DescIT: Il suo enorme potere psichico è concentrato nelle gemme sulle teste.

Pokedex.Name: Onix (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: Due to the different rocks it digests now, this Onix is now faster and more defensive.
Pokedex.DescIT: Le rocce diverse che mangia lo rendono più veloce e più resistente.

Pokedex.Name: Steelix (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: Due to the strange black rocks it eats, Steelix is a lot less sturdy than its Johto counterpart. However, it's more aggressive.
Pokedex.DescIT: Le strane rocce nere che mangia lo rendono meno robusto, ma più aggressivo.

Pokedex.Name: Jellycle
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon is found deep in the sea where its cold and cruel nature pairs well with the freezing waters.
Pokedex.DescIT: Vive in acque profonde e gelide, adatte al suo carattere freddo e crudele.

Pokedex.Name: Tundregal
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon has an air of arrogance about it. It regularly gets into feuds with Porprince over their nobility.
Pokedex.DescIT: Arrogante; litiga spesso con Porprince su chi sia più nobile.

Pokedex.Name: Hopple
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon is found in great abundance all over Sundor. Some consider it to be a nuisance.
Pokedex.DescIT: Diffusissimo ovunque; c'è chi lo considera una seccatura.

Pokedex.Name: Rabbrute
Pokedex.DexDescription: This hulking beast is quite dangerous. This Pokémon is the result of a large group of frenzied Hopple.
Pokedex.DescIT: Bestione pericoloso, nato da un grande gruppo di Hopple in preda alla frenesia.

Pokedex.Name: Purrloin (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: This ghoulish Pokémon haunts the graveyards of Sundor. They love to spook people at night.
Pokedex.DescIT: Infesta i cimiteri e di notte ama spaventare la gente.

Pokedex.Name: Liepard (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: Liepard in the Sundor region have become vengeful spirits who take revenge on people who mistreat their Pokémon.
Pokedex.DescIT: Spirito vendicativo che punisce chi maltratta i propri Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Glixie
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon is loved in all of Sundor. They are a common Pokémon to gift to small children as pets.
Pokedex.DescIT: Amatissimo; viene spesso regalato ai bambini come compagno.

Pokedex.Name: Leadlite
Pokedex.DexDescription: These peaceful Pokémon guide lost people and Pokémon back to their homes during the night.
Pokedex.DescIT: Pacifico; di notte riporta a casa persone e Pokémon smarriti.

Pokedex.Name: Budew (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: Sundor's harsh environment has caused Budew to become more toxic. It is sad because it thinks trainers are ignoring it.
Pokedex.DescIT: L'ambiente ostile l'ha reso più tossico; è triste perché crede che gli allenatori lo ignorino.

Pokedex.Name: Roselia (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon has come to terms with its loneliness, embracing its toxic power. Trainers must prove themselves to befriend it.
Pokedex.DescIT: Ha accettato la solitudine e il suo potere tossico; per diventare suoi amici bisogna dimostrare di valere.

Pokedex.Name: Oleade
Pokedex.DexDescription: Oleade are incredibly faithful Pokémon. They use their poisonous bouquets to protect their trainers in any way they can.
Pokedex.DescIT: Fedelissimo; protegge il suo allenatore con i suoi mazzi di fiori velenosi.

Pokedex.Name: Veilarva
Pokedex.DexDescription: Veilarva spend most of there their days absorbing solar and lunar rays till they store enough energy and evolve.
Pokedex.DescIT: Assorbe raggi di sole e di luna finché non ha energia sufficiente per evolversi.

Pokedex.Name: Solacoon
Pokedex.DexDescription: The crystal Solacoon holds is formed out of the access solar energy from when it was a Veilarva. It said that it uses the crystal to forsee the best spot to absorb sunlight.
Pokedex.DescIT: Il suo cristallo nasce dall'energia solare in eccesso; lo usa per trovare il posto migliore dove prendere il sole.

Pokedex.Name: Scarasol
Pokedex.DexDescription: Scarasol use the crystal in-between their horns to channel their psychic powers. They share a fierce rivalry with their counterpart Scaranox.
Pokedex.DescIT: Incanala i poteri psichici con il cristallo tra le corna; acerrimo rivale di Scaranox.

Pokedex.Name: Pyefern
Pokedex.DexDescription: Pyefern care and protect those who follow them, many pokemon that do so tend to bring them food and offerings. Because of this pyefern is known as the queen of the meadow.
Pokedex.DescIT: Protegge chi lo segue e ne riceve cibo e offerte: è la «regina del prato».

Pokedex.Name: Coralarc
Pokedex.DexDescription: Coralarc live off the reefs south of Almera until there brave enough to swim out into deeper waters. There they can find special item's that help them evolve.
Pokedex.DescIT: Vive sulla barriera corallina finché non ha il coraggio di andare al largo, dove trova gli strumenti per evolversi.

Pokedex.Name: Thresharc
Pokedex.DexDescription: One of the apex predators off the southern coast of Almera, thresharc are able to sense electrical currents in humans and other Pokémon, this gives them an advantage while hunting and allows them to detect intruders in their territory from miles away.
Pokedex.DescIT: Predatore al vertice della costa; percepisce le correnti elettriche di persone e Pokémon a chilometri.

Pokedex.Name: Steelarc
Pokedex.DescIT: Scheda senza testo: c'è solo il disegno.
Notes: tipo non indicato da nessuna scheda: Acqua/Acciaio è una proposta ricavata dal nome e dal Dente d'Acciaio

Pokedex.Name: Flofiny
Pokedex.DexDescription: Flofiny live happily off the southern reef of Almera playing with people and pokemon alike. Flofiny have been given the title of protectors of the reef for rescuing surfers and swimmers in trouble, as well as keep the rivalry between steelarc & thresharc out of the reef.
Pokedex.DescIT: Gioca con persone e Pokémon sulla barriera; salva i nuotatori e tiene lontana la rivalità tra Steelarc e Thresharc.
Pokedex.AbilSrc: da Finizen (il modello ha solo Zero to Hero, abilità unica di Palafin)

Pokedex.Name: Duscyx
Pokedex.DexDescription: This pokemon scurry's across the deserts at high speeds to avoid predators. It makes its home by burrowing into rocks in the desert.
Pokedex.DescIT: Corre velocissimo nel deserto per sfuggire ai predatori; scava la tana nelle rocce.

Pokedex.Name: Dustryl
Pokedex.DexDescription: Dustryl can run up to sixty miles per hour. They also can run without resting for at least three hours. It's said that it can find water in the deserts using it Beck like a dowsing rod.
Pokedex.DescIT: Corre fino a circa 97 km/h per tre ore di fila; trova l'acqua usando il becco come una bacchetta da rabdomante.

Pokedex.Name: Prairyote
Pokedex.DexDescription: This pokemon whips up a sandstorm to hide in while it stocks its prey, once it sees it's prey is confused in strikes. An old story of legend tells of a powerful pack of prairyote that caused the desert to exist in the region.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si nasconde in una tempesta di sabbia e colpisce la preda confusa; per una leggenda, un branco ha creato il deserto.

Pokedex.Name: Froshorn
Pokedex.DexDescription: Archeological digs have discovered that Froshorn fossils have been found in multiple regions acrossed the world. Many Paleontologists think it migrated to new region's to find new food sources.
Pokedex.DescIT: I suoi fossili si trovano in molte regioni: si pensa migrasse in cerca di cibo.

Pokedex.Name: Glacielk
Pokedex.DexDescription: Glacielk lived in the great plains of Almera 2.4 million years ago. It's sturdy thick horns were encased in ice for more durability, it is also one of the tallest recorded fossils of it's time period.
Pokedex.DescIT: Viveva nelle pianure 2,4 milioni di anni fa; corna rivestite di ghiaccio, tra i fossili più alti della sua epoca.

Pokedex.Name: Eevee
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokemon is extremely rare to find. Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates to fit its environment. Radiation from various stones causes this Pokemon to evolve.
Pokedex.DescIT: Pokémon canon. Qui evolve in 10 forme nuove (086–095).

Evolutions.Special: Level up holding it in a forest

Pokedex.Name: Meleeon
Pokedex.DexDescription: This pokemon will never back down from a fight no matter the odds using swift attacks to corner its foes.
Pokedex.DescIT: Non si tira mai indietro: mette all'angolo gli avversari con attacchi rapidi.

Pokedex.Name: Toxieon
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon admits a toxic gas that will Instantly poison those that inhale it.
Pokedex.DescIT: Emette un gas tossico che avvelena all'istante chi lo respira.

Pokedex.Name: Sandeon
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon has adapted to Almera's harsh desert environment as its fur collects sand using it as a protective coat.
Pokedex.DescIT: Adattato al deserto: la pelliccia raccoglie la sabbia e gli fa da armatura.

Pokedex.Name: Kireon
Pokedex.DexDescription: It is said that a Kireon will only follow a trainer that is pure of heart.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si dice che segua solo un allenatore puro di cuore.

Pokedex.Name: Insecteon
Pokedex.DexDescription: When it vibrates the wings on its back together it emits a high frequency sound that disorients enemies.
Pokedex.DescIT: Facendo vibrare le ali emette un suono acutissimo che disorienta i nemici.

Evolutions.Special: Level up holding it in a forest

Pokedex.Name: Gusteon
Pokedex.DexDescription: Gusteon can make their bodies light as a feather, when in flight it looks as if they are walking on air.
Pokedex.DescIT: Rende il corpo leggero come una piuma: in volo sembra camminare nell'aria.

Pokedex.Name: Magneon
Pokedex.DexDescription: Magneon can manipulate magnetic polarities, it can give itself and other objects a positive or negative charge.
Pokedex.DescIT: Manipola le polarità magnetiche, caricando se stesso e gli oggetti.

Pokedex.Name: Oreon
Pokedex.DexDescription: The diamond like hide on Oreon's body is highly coveted by jewelers of the Almera region.
Pokedex.DescIT: La sua pelle simile al diamante è ricercatissima dai gioiellieri.

Pokedex.Name: Normeon
Pokedex.DexDescription: When an eevee is exposed to a moon stone It undergoes a slight evolution, many scientists believe this is eevee's true evolution.
Pokedex.DescIT: Eevee esposto a una Pietralunare; molti scienziati la considerano la sua vera evoluzione.

Pokedex.Name: Specteon
Pokedex.DexDescription: This pokemon is said to guide spirits that have lost their way to the afterlife.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si dice guidi nell'aldilà gli spiriti che hanno perso la strada.

Pokedex.Name: Chatot
Pokedex.DexDescription: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them and prevent attacks. Chatot who live with humans learn words and phrases, but it's unknown it they really know their meaning. Their imitations are very convincing.
Pokedex.DescIT: Pokémon canon. Qui evolve in Lyrebird (097).

Pokedex.Name: Lyrebird · Pianissimo
Pokedex.DexDescription: Much like their pre-evolution Lyrebird is Capable of human speech and can mimic any voice they ever heard perfectly, as long as they remember the voice.
Pokedex.DescIT: Come Chatot parla e imita alla perfezione ogni voce che ricorda.

Pokedex.Name: Lyrebird · Fortissimo
Pokedex.DexDescription: Lyrebird can not only can mimic a voice but talk in complete sentences using the voices they remember, so long as they know the words.
Pokedex.DescIT: Oltre a imitare le voci, le usa per dire frasi complete, se conosce le parole.

Pokedex.Name: Darcomy
Pokedex.DexDescription: Darcomy, highly aggressive they hunt & feed on Skorupi's and Almeraian Sizzlipede's. Over time they grew an immunity to poisons from constant battles with these pokemon.
Pokedex.DescIT: Aggressivo; caccia Skorupi e Sizzlipede ed è diventato immune ai veleni.
Pokedex.AbilSrc: da Pikachu (il modello ha solo Hunger Switch, abilità unica di Morpeko; Darcomy è il «Pikachu» della regione)

Pokedex.Name: Nectrant
Pokedex.DexDescription: Making there home's in warm dry climates Nectrant survive by storing up nutrients from berry's and other food sources near their colony.
Pokedex.DescIT: Vive in climi caldi e secchi; sopravvive accumulando nutrienti nella colonia.

Pokedex.Name: Nectreen
Pokedex.DexDescription: The nectar from Nectreen has a thick honey like consistency and just as sweet. Some people collect the nectar and sale it for good money.
Pokedex.DescIT: Il suo nettare è denso e dolce come il miele; c'è chi lo raccoglie e lo vende.

Pokedex.Name: Ullowl
Pokedex.DexDescription: Solitary pokemon Ullowl live in remote areas of Almera near the Evertall Forest and the Gogoat Mountain Range. Most that see one lose sight of it quickly though as it hides and bends in with it's surroundings.
Pokedex.DescIT: Solitario, vive in zone remote; si mimetizza e sparisce subito alla vista.

Pokedex.Name: Omenowl
Pokedex.DexDescription: People Interpret an Omenowl sighting as a sign that change is coming, whether it's good or bad nobody knows.
Pokedex.DescIT: Vederlo è segno che sta arrivando un cambiamento, buono o cattivo.

Pokedex.Name: Puffun
Pokedex.DexDescription: Puffun loves to slide down the mountain slopes racing pokemon and people alike. If a snowboarder or skier wants to improve there skills on the slopes practicing against Puffun is the best training partner.
Pokedex.DescIT: Ama scivolare giù per le piste sfidando persone e Pokémon: il miglior compagno di allenamento sugli sci.
Pokedex.AbilSrc: da Spheal (il modello ha solo Ice Face, abilità unica di Eiscue)

Pokedex.Name: Inveleton
Pokedex.DexDescription: After finding the remains of a deceased Pokémon Inveleton will possess the bones and gain new forms. Its attitude is known to change depending on the bones it possesses.
Pokedex.DescIT: Possiede le ossa dei Pokémon morti: cambia forma e carattere a seconda delle ossa.

Evolutions.Special: Possesses the skull of a deer Pokemon
Possesses the skull of a bird Pokemon
Possesses the shell of a turtle Pokemon

Pokedex.AbilSrc: da Marowak (Alolan Form) (stesse abilità delle sue forme)

Pokedex.Name: Inveleton · Teschio di Cervo
Pokedex.DexDescription: Inveleton Deer skull form taps into the dormant psychic powers of the deceased Pokémon. It is said that if you look into the glowing orbs in its antlers you can see your past life.
Pokedex.DescIT: Risveglia i poteri psichici del defunto; nelle sfere tra le corna si vedrebbe la propria vita passata.

Evolutions.Special: Possesses the skull of a deer Pokemon

Pokedex.Name: Inveleton · Teschio di Uccello
Pokedex.DexDescription: Inveleton Bird skull form gain a new sense of confidence and bravery. This form can be found flying through the night skies of Almera, it has been known to lead lost travelers out of the desert.
Pokedex.DescIT: Diventa coraggioso; vola di notte e guida i viaggiatori smarriti fuori dal deserto.

Evolutions.Special: Possesses the skull of a bird Pokemon

Pokedex.Name: Inveleton · Guscio di Tartaruga
Pokedex.DexDescription: Inveleton Turtle shell form can manipulate the flames it produces to form shapes. Ancient storytellers of Almera used this ability to tell vivid campfire stories.
Pokedex.DescIT: Modella le sue fiamme in figure: gli antichi narratori lo usavano per i racconti attorno al fuoco.

Evolutions.Special: Possesses the shell of a turtle Pokemon

Pokedex.Name: Reveream
Pokedex.DexDescription: Reveream was said to be created by an Almeraian shaman from ancient times. Most keep a reveream in there home's to ward off bad dreams.
Pokedex.DescIT: Creato da uno sciamano antico; lo si tiene in casa per tenere lontani gli incubi.

Pokedex.Name: Wispur
Pokedex.DexDescription: A Pokémon cursed to wander the cold forests aimlessly. No one knows what they're looking for.
Pokedex.DescIT: Maledetto a vagare senza meta nelle foreste fredde; nessuno sa cosa cerchi.

Pokedex.Name: Furmanence
Pokedex.DexDescription: Its tail glows bright to guide lost Wispur to where they need to go. Sometimes it can even trick trainers to follow.
Pokedex.DescIT: La coda luminosa guida i Wispur smarriti; a volte inganna gli allenatori per farsi seguire.

Pokedex.Name: Squabadore
Pokedex.DexDescription: Even though it can be found throughout the Xinhua region, this Pokémon didn't originate here. It's speculated they came from Paldea, but no one is certain.
Pokedex.DescIT: Diffuso ovunque ma non originario della regione; forse viene da Paldea.

Pokedex.Name: Chirpunk
Pokedex.DexDescription: It's well-known to stay away from flocks of Chirpunk. They are extremely territorial, ensuring you get nowhere near their turf.
Pokedex.DescIT: Molto territoriale: meglio stare lontani dai suoi stormi.

Pokedex.Name: Komatross
Pokedex.DexDescription: Leaders of the flock send Chirpunk cronies to take care of tasks beneath them. Occasionally, fights for territory break out with neighboring Honchkrow and Murkrow.
Pokedex.DescIT: Capo dello stormo, manda i Chirpunk a fare il lavoro sporco; litiga per il territorio con Honchkrow e Murkrow.

Pokedex.Name: Lotad (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: Sometimes seen ferrying weak Pokémon across the lakes it inhabits. Where it takes them is unknown.
Pokedex.DescIT: Traghetta i Pokémon deboli attraverso i laghi; nessuno sa dove li porti.

Pokedex.Name: Lombre (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: They spend most of their time under the water only coming up to scare anglers. They almost seem to hop on the water's surface.
Pokedex.DescIT: Vive sott'acqua e sale solo per spaventare i pescatori; sembra saltellare sull'acqua.

Pokedex.Name: Ludighouli
Pokedex.DexDescription: It hides in ponds or lakes disguised as a water lily. It has been known to drag prey deep into the ocean to drain their vitality.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si traveste da ninfea e trascina le prede negli abissi per prosciugarne l'energia.

Pokedex.Name: Fweeble
Pokedex.DexDescription: They thrive in unsanitary environments and feed on trash with groups of up to 20 at a time.
Pokedex.DescIT: Vive negli ambienti sporchi e mangia rifiuti in gruppi fino a 20.

Pokedex.Name: Fwobble
Pokedex.DexDescription: While it certainly can fly, they are not all too good at it. Because of their small wings, its flight pattern is often sporadic.
Pokedex.DescIT: Vola, ma male: con le ali piccole il suo volo è irregolare.

Pokedex.Name: Fwuuna
Pokedex.DexDescription: Fwuuna hum a distinct tune while sucking up the nectar of flowers. They use the energy collected to play pranks and spread mischief.
Pokedex.DescIT: Canticchia mentre succhia il nettare e usa l'energia per fare scherzi.

Pokedex.Name: Hoothoot (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: When emerging from the ground, parts of the nest stick to them, forming the ball of dirt and mud that hugs their mid-section.
Pokedex.DescIT: Uscendo da terra, pezzi del nido gli restano attaccati: è la palla di fango sul suo corpo.

Pokedex.Name: Noctremor
Pokedex.DexDescription: They are aggressive and protective when it comes to their young. They attack almost anything that moves toward a Hoothoot of the nest.
Pokedex.DescIT: Aggressivo e protettivo con i piccoli: attacca tutto ciò che si avvicina al nido.

Pokedex.Name: Paras (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: You can never be too sure whether a stray pot or jar has a Paras in it. They hide to get the upper hand on prey.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si nasconde in vasi e giare per sorprendere le prede.

Pokedex.Name: Parascare
Pokedex.DexDescription: No one is sure what the actual Pokémon is. Is it the jar? A poison? Or something else entirely…
Pokedex.DescIT: Nessuno sa quale sia il vero Pokémon: la giara, il veleno o qualcos'altro.

Pokedex.Name: Jellantern
Pokedex.DexDescription: Jellantern don't live in the water. However, they can sometimes be seen floating on the water's surface.
Pokedex.DescIT: Non vive in acqua, ma a volte lo si vede galleggiare in superficie.

Pokedex.Name: Flumiairy
Pokedex.DexDescription: Schools of Flumiairy dance under the full moon to welcome a coming seasonal change. It's a big event for the region.
Pokedex.DescIT: Gruppi di Flumiairy danzano sotto la luna piena per salutare il cambio di stagione: è un grande evento.

Pokedex.Name: Tonozumi
Pokedex.DexDescription: If threatened by a predator, this Pokémon can jump up to 10 feet into the air.
Pokedex.DescIT: Se minacciato salta fino a circa 3 metri d'altezza.

Pokedex.Name: Magiskipper
Pokedex.DexDescription: Though it resembles Magikarp, Magiskipper is a completely different species. They typically live in burrows near the ocean.
Pokedex.DescIT: Somiglia a Magikarp ma è un'altra specie; vive in tane vicino al mare.

Pokedex.Name: Gyaradune
Pokedex.DexDescription: It burrows and tunnels through the deserts of Xinhua. It creates waves of sand on the surface and attacks with electrical discharges.
Pokedex.DescIT: Scava gallerie nel deserto, solleva onde di sabbia e attacca con scariche elettriche.

Pokedex.Name: Buneary (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: When the stars shine bright, groups of Buneary can be seen hopping high, trying to jump all the way to the moon.
Pokedex.DescIT: Nelle notti stellate salta in gruppo cercando di arrivare alla luna.

Pokedex.Name: Lopunny (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: It defends any Pokémon in need. They can sometimes be seen carrying young Buneary around to give them the experience of flying.
Pokedex.DescIT: Difende i Pokémon in difficoltà; porta in giro i Buneary per fargli provare il volo.

Pokedex.Name: Meeno
Pokedex.DexDescription: Schools of Meeno gather to perform for one another—each trying to steal the spotlight from the rest.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si esibisce in gruppo, e ognuno cerca di rubare la scena agli altri.

Pokedex.Name: Masquergeon
Pokedex.DexDescription: Its tail isn't all that sharp. It makes up for it with its steel-like scales covering its entire body.
Pokedex.DescIT: La coda non è molto affilata, ma il corpo è coperto di scaglie simili all'acciaio.

Pokedex.Name: Amoramur
Pokedex.DexDescription: It's highly skilled at all kinds of performance. It dances and sings with grace, all for a little attention.
Pokedex.DescIT: Abilissimo in ogni esibizione: danza e canta con grazia per avere attenzioni.

Pokedex.Name: Torkoal (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: Its shell is much softer than it looks. Not a lot is known about how it flies, but it is thought to have something to do with the cloud-like substance it blows out.
Pokedex.DescIT: Il guscio è più morbido di quanto sembri; forse vola grazie alla sostanza simile a nuvole che emette.

Evolutions.Special: On the top of Mt. Feng

Pokedex.Name: Tortower
Pokedex.DexDescription: They slowly fly through the air looking for a place to land and sleep. After their rest and a quick snack, they'll fly away in search of the next spot to sleep again.
Pokedex.DescIT: Vola lentamente cercando un posto dove atterrare e dormire; dopo un pisolino e uno spuntino riparte.

Evolutions.Special: On the top of Mt. Feng

Pokedex.Name: Teaphant
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. It used to roam the entire region around 2,500 years ago where it was respected and worshiped.
Pokedex.DescIT: Riportato in vita da un fossile; 2.500 anni fa era rispettato e venerato.

Pokedex.Name: Ivoregal
Pokedex.DexDescription: It shouldn't be possible, but there are stories of Ivoregal producing a poisonous substance and feeding it to people it doesn't like.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si racconta che produca una sostanza velenosa e la offra a chi non gli piace.

Pokedex.Name: Scrapeep
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. They are extremely light and can be blown away by a gentle breeze.
Pokedex.DescIT: Riportato in vita da un fossile; così leggero che lo porta via una brezza.

Pokedex.Name: Aerigami
Pokedex.DexDescription: A Pokémon that thrived around 260,000 years ago. They were known for their long wingspans, quick flight speeds, and cuts as sharp as blades.
Pokedex.DescIT: Viveva 260.000 anni fa; ali lunghe, volo veloce e tagli affilati come lame.

Pokedex.Name: Frostot
Pokedex.DexDescription: It lives high on the mountains throughout the region. It may even be the highest altitude grass Pokémon that lives today.
Pokedex.DescIT: Vive in alta montagna; forse il Pokémon Erba che vive più in alto.

Pokedex.Name: Frostwirl
Pokedex.DexDescription: A rare sight on the mountains of Xinhua. It's able to skate even when there is no ice.
Pokedex.DescIT: Raro da vedere in montagna; pattina anche dove non c'è ghiaccio.

Pokedex.Name: Bambabii
Pokedex.DexDescription: Its tears are used in fertilizers that help plants and crops thrive in Xinhua's colder climates.
Pokedex.DescIT: Le sue lacrime servono a fertilizzare le colture nei climi freddi.

Pokedex.Name: Matriarbor
Pokedex.DexDescription: They are vital during the harvest seasons. They care for any injured Pokémon like it's one of their own.
Pokedex.DescIT: Indispensabile nei raccolti; cura i Pokémon feriti come fossero suoi.

Pokedex.Name: Seedread
Pokedex.DexDescription: They seem to be very docile and spend most of their days wandering the cold bamboo forests as if looking for something… or someone…
Pokedex.DescIT: Docile; vaga nelle fredde foreste di bambù come se cercasse qualcosa… o qualcuno.

Pokedex.Name: Hatenna (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: It hides in the deep snow of Mt Feng looking for travelers. It has been known to lure people deeper into its territory.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si nasconde nella neve e attira i viaggiatori sempre più dentro il suo territorio.

Pokedex.Name: Hattrem (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DexDescription: It is sensitive to the falling snow of the region and knows the mountain's entire climate just by listening.
Pokedex.DescIT: Sensibile alla neve che cade: conosce il clima della montagna solo ascoltando.

Pokedex.Name: Hexerene
Pokedex.DexDescription: It disguises itself as mirages to captivate people and drain their soul right out of them.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si traveste da miraggio per incantare le persone e prosciugarne l'anima.

Pokedex.Name: Cuddlin
Pokedex.DexDescription: Cuddlin are playful and carefree. Sometimes they don't realize their own strength and can roughhouse a little too hard.
Pokedex.DescIT: Giocoso e spensierato; a volte non si rende conto della propria forza.

Pokedex.Name: Rafflin
Pokedex.DexDescription: It gives off a serious and mythical aura. Stories say that the ancient emperors all had a Rafflin by their side.
Pokedex.DescIT: Ha un'aura seria e mistica; si dice che gli antichi imperatori ne avessero uno al fianco.

Pokedex.Name: Sympholin
Pokedex.DexDescription: It is said that their arrival is tied to the birth or death of a wise sage or ruler.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si dice che arrivi alla nascita o alla morte di un saggio o di un sovrano.

Pokedex.Name: Misdreavus (forma regionale)
Pokedex.DescIT: Testo del Pokédex non disponibile.

Pokedex.Name: Mismarvelus
Pokedex.DescIT: Testo del Pokédex non disponibile.

Pokedex.Name: Regiseer
Pokedex.DexDescription: There are theories that before a human or Pokémon is born, Regiseer has carefully crafted its soul and determined its life story.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si pensa che crei l'anima di ogni essere prima della nascita e ne scriva la storia.

Pokedex.Name: Regighoul
Pokedex.DexDescription: It is believed that after a person passes, Regighoul takes their soul to the afterlife. Sometimes lost souls become Pokémon.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si crede che accompagni le anime nell'aldilà; a volte le anime perdute diventano Pokémon.

Pokedex.Name: Rainboa
Pokedex.DexDescription: This Pokémon is said to have used its legendary power to create the Sundor region and give life to its inhabitants.
Pokedex.DescIT: Si dice che abbia creato la regione e dato vita ai suoi abitanti.

Pokedex.Name: Prizmrow
Pokedex.DexDescription: Prizmrow's feathers refract light into dazzling colors, creating a shifting rainbow aura that trails behind it as it flies. Ancient tales say Prizmrow once carried a sacred flame through the frozen sky to save the world from eternal winter.
Pokedex.DescIT: Le sue piume creano un'aura arcobaleno; la leggenda dice che portò una fiamma sacra salvando il mondo dall'inverno eterno.

Adaptability.Name: Adaptability
Adaptability.Effect: Whenever this Pokemon uses a Physical or Special Move that matches their Type, add 1 Extra die to the Damage pool of that Move.
Adaptability.Description: The Pokemon will easily adapt to its surroundings, it will travel with ease, no matter the terrain.
Adaptability.EffectIT: Le sue mosse fisiche o speciali dello stesso tipo del Pokémon ottengono 1 dado extra al Danno.

Aftermath.Name: Aftermath
Aftermath.Effect: If this Pokemon faints due to a Non-Ranged Physical Move, the User of that attack is dealt 2 Damage.
Aftermath.Description: When hurt or upset, the Pokemon will prepare to burst. If hit hard enough, it will explode on contact. They also tend to hold grudges.
Aftermath.EffectIT: Se va KO per una mossa fisica non a distanza, chi l'ha colpito subisce 2 danni.

Anger Point.Name: Anger Point
Anger Point.Effect: If a foe lands a Critical Hit on this Pokemon, increase this Pokemon's Strength Attribute by 3.
Anger Point.Description: The Pokemon will easily get aggressive. Little to no provocation is needed for it to start throwing a tantrum and ripping everything to shreds.
Anger Point.EffectIT: Se un avversario gli infligge un colpo critico, la sua Strength aumenta di 3.

Anticipation.Name: Anticipation
Anticipation.Effect: If any foe knows a Move that would deal Lethal or Super Effective damage against this Pokemon, it will alert its Trainer.
Anticipation.Description: The Pokemon is always alert for threats and rarely sits to relax. If it perceives a potential danger it will get anxious and start shuddering.
Anticipation.EffectIT: Se un avversario conosce una mossa che gli infliggerebbe danno Letale o superefficace, avvisa il suo Allenatore.

Arena Trap.Name: Arena Trap
Arena Trap.Effect: Pokemon entering or already on the foe's side of the field become blocked as long as this Pokemon is on the field. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
Arena Trap.Description: The ground around this Pokemon becomes really soft and hard to walk in. When in danger, it will sink the ground around itself creating a shifting sand pit.
Arena Trap.EffectIT: Finché è in campo, i Pokémon avversari che entrano o sono già in campo restano Bloccati. Non ha effetto su chi è immune alle mosse Terra.

Battle Armor.Name: Battle Armor
Battle Armor.Effect: If a foe lands a Critical Hit on this Pokemon, it won't get any Bonus Dice on its Damage Dice pool for it.
Battle Armor.Description: The skin of the Pokemon is covered by plates of a very resistant material, like rock, steel, or an exoskeleton.
Battle Armor.EffectIT: Se un avversario gli infligge un colpo critico, non ottiene dadi bonus al Danno per il critico.

Big Pecks.Name: Big Pecks
Big Pecks.Effect: This Pokemon cannot have its Defense reduced.
Big Pecks.Description: This tenacious Pokemon uses its beak to cover its weak spots.
Big Pecks.EffectIT: La sua Difesa non può essere ridotta.

Blaze.Name: Blaze
Blaze.Effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Fire-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Fire-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.
Blaze.Description: The inner and outer fire on this Pokemon's body will burn incredibly fierce just before fading.
Blaze.EffectIT: La penalità da dolore non riduce i successi dei tiri di Precisione e Danno delle sue mosse Fuoco. Con metà PS o meno, le mosse Fuoco ottengono 2 dadi extra al Danno.

Clear Body.Name: Clear Body
Clear Body.Effect: Other Pokemon cannot Increase or Reduce the Attributes of this Pokemon. This Pokemon can still Increase or Reduce its own Attributes.
Clear Body.Description: The Pokemon is completely aware of all its body surroundings, trying to sneak on it will be incredibly difficult.
Clear Body.EffectIT: Gli altri Pokémon non possono aumentare né ridurre i suoi attributi. Può ancora modificarli da solo.

Clear Conscience.Name: Clear Conscience
Clear Conscience.Effect: This Pokemon is not affected by the Confused and Love Status Conditions, nor by the effects of Taunt and Torment.
Clear Conscience.EffectIT: Non subisce Confusione e Infatuazione, né gli effetti di Provocazione e Attaccalite.

Cloud Nine.Name: Cloud Nine
Cloud Nine.Effect: Negate the effects of Weather Conditions on this Pokemon.
Cloud Nine.Description: This Pokemon will easily feel pleased, and it's prone to be happier than others. No matter if it's sunny or rainy it will never feel gloomy.
Cloud Nine.EffectIT: Annulla su di lui gli effetti del tempo atmosferico.

Commanding Presence.Name: Commanding Presence
Commanding Presence.Effect: When this Pokemon comes out, all foes in Range roll Insight. Those scoring fewer than 2 successes must target this Pokemon with their Single-Target Moves during the next Round.
Commanding Presence.EffectIT: Quando entra in campo, ogni avversario a portata tira Insight: chi ottiene meno di 2 successi deve bersagliare lui con le mosse a bersaglio singolo nel round successivo.

Compound Eyes.Name: Compound Eyes
Compound Eyes.Effect: This Pokemon gets 2 Extra Dice on the Accuracy Pool of any move with Low Accuracy.
Compound Eyes.Description: This Pokemon has peripheral vision that allows it to locate its targets with great precision.
Compound Eyes.EffectIT: Ottiene 2 dadi extra alla Precisione di ogni mossa con Precisione Ridotta.

Corrosion.Name: Corrosion
Corrosion.Effect: Ignore any immunity the foe has to Poison-Type Damage and/or to be inflicted Poison and Badly Poisoned Status Ailments.
Corrosion.Description: This Pokemon's venom can eat through metal, wood, and most inorganic and organic materials. Be careful not to touch it.
Corrosion.EffectIT: Ignora l'immunità del bersaglio al danno Veleno e agli stati Avvelenamento e Iperavvelenamento.

Creepy-Crawly.Name: Creepy-Crawly
Creepy-Crawly.Effect: Bug-Type Moves used by this Pokemon get 1 Extra Die to their Damage Pool.
Creepy-Crawly.EffectIT: Le sue mosse Coleottero ottengono 1 dado extra al Danno.

Cursed Body.Name: Cursed Body
Cursed Body.Effect: Whenever this Pokemon is dealt damage with a Physical or Special Move, Roll 3 Chance Dice to Disable that Move. Up to 3 Moves may be disabled this way.
Cursed Body.Description: This Pokemon carries a curse within itself. Crossing this Pokemon is not a good idea.
Cursed Body.EffectIT: Quando subisce danno da una mossa fisica o speciale, tira 3 Dadi Probabilità per Inibire (Inibitore) quella mossa. Fino a 3 mosse inibite così.

Cute Charm.Name: Cute Charm
Cute Charm.Effect: If this Pokemon is hit with a Non-Ranged Physical Move, roll 3 Chance Dice to make the foe fall in Love.
Cute Charm.Description: It may be its twinkly eyes or its rosy cheeks, but other people and Pokemon will try to win this Pokemon's heart.
Cute Charm.EffectIT: Se viene colpito da una mossa fisica non a distanza, tira 3 Dadi Probabilità per far Infatuare l'avversario.

Damp.Name: Damp
Damp.Effect: No one in the field will be able to use the moves: Self-Destruct, Explosion, Misty Explosion, Mind Blown, and Burn Up while this Pokemon is in the field. The Ability Aftermath does not activate if this Pokemon is in the field.
Damp.Description: The Pokemon gathers the humidity in the air around itself. Lighting a spark or keeping a fire on, will be almost impossible close to it.
Damp.EffectIT: Finché è in campo nessuno può usare Autodistruzione, Esplosione, Nebbioesplosione, Mentebomba e Bruciatutto; l'abilità Scoppio non si attiva.

Defiant.Name: Defiant
Defiant.Effect: The first time this Pokemon has an Attribute reduced during a battle, Increase its Strength by 2.
Defiant.Description: This Pokemon will not yield, the harder the situation gets, the higher its fighting spirit will grow. It may, however, be a bit of a rebel.
Defiant.EffectIT: La prima volta in battaglia che un suo attributo viene ridotto, la sua Strength aumenta di 2.

Drizzle.Name: Drizzle
Drizzle.Effect: When this Pokemon comes out, it automatically starts the effects of Rain Weather. The effects end when the Pokemon leaves the battle. (In case of stalemate the Pokemon with higher Will might keep the dominant weather)
Drizzle.Description: The sky will keep raining in an apparent never-ending storm for as long as this Pokemon wants to.
Drizzle.EffectIT: Quando entra in campo attiva il tempo Pioggia, che finisce quando esce dalla battaglia (in caso di parità prevale chi ha più Volontà).

Dry Skin.Name: Dry Skin
Dry Skin.Effect: While Sunny Weather is active, this Pokemon will receive 1 damage at the end of each round. Fire attacks will deal 1 additional Damage to this Pokemon. Water attacks may heal 1 HP to this Pokemon instead of dealing damage.
Dry Skin.Description: The skin of this Pokemon needs special care as it is very dry and brittle, it'll require constant hydration and protection against the sun.
Dry Skin.EffectIT: Col tempo Soleggiato subisce 1 danno a fine round e le mosse Fuoco gli fanno 1 danno in più. Le mosse Acqua possono curargli 1 PS invece di danneggiarlo.

Early Bird.Name: Early Bird
Early Bird.Effect: The time this Pokemon would be asleep is reduced by half and it will only need to score 2 successes on its Insight roll to wake up in battle. This effect does not apply for the Move "Rest".
Early Bird.Description: Pokemon with this ability are light sleepers that will easily rise from slumber. They wake up full of energy with just a couple hours of sleep.
Early Bird.EffectIT: Il Sonno gli dura la metà e in battaglia gli bastano 2 successi al tiro di Insight per svegliarsi (non vale per Riposo).

Electric Surge.Name: Electric Surge
Electric Surge.Effect: When this Pokemon comes out, it automatically starts the effects of the Move Electric Terrain. (In case of stalemate the Pokemon with higher Will might keep the dominant Terrain)
Electric Surge.Description: The Pokemon can surround itself with an electric field that fills the air with tension and keeps everyone on edge.
Electric Surge.EffectIT: Quando entra in campo attiva il Campo Elettrico (in caso di parità prevale chi ha più Volontà).

Fairy Aura.Name: Fairy Aura
Fairy Aura.Effect: Increase 2 dice to all Damage Pools of Fairy-Type Moves of all Pokemon in the field. This effect does not stack. Pokemon and Trainers on the field will not attack the user of this Ability. Unique Ability.
Fairy Aura.Description: A powerful pink glowing aura comes out of this Pokemon, covering the field in a glimmering light, filling everyone's hearts with peace, hope, and love.
Fairy Aura.EffectIT: Tutte le mosse Folletto in campo ottengono 2 dadi extra al Danno (non cumulabile). Pokémon e Allenatori in campo non attaccano chi ha questa abilità. Abilità unica.

Flame Body.Name: Flame Body
Flame Body.Effect: When hit by a Non-Ranged Physical Move, this Pokemon rolls 3 Chance Dice to inflict 2nd degree Burn on the foe.
Flame Body.Description: This Pokemon can willingly ignite its body on fire, receiving no harm from it. Objects that come into contact with this Pokemon may catch fire.
Flame Body.EffectIT: Se viene colpito da una mossa fisica non a distanza, tira 3 Dadi Probabilità per infliggere Scottatura di 2° grado all'avversario.

Flash Fire.Name: Flash Fire
Flash Fire.Effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by a Fire-Type move, add 1 Extra die to the Damage Pool of Fire-type Moves this Pokemon uses until the end of the scene. Fire-type moves do not deal damage to this Pokemon.
Flash Fire.Description: This Pokemon is capable of consuming other fire sources and adding them to its own. Walking through embers, fire, lava and hell feel like a breeze to it.
Flash Fire.EffectIT: Le mosse Fuoco non gli fanno danno. La prima volta che ne viene colpito, le sue mosse Fuoco ottengono 1 dado extra al Danno fino a fine scena.

Flower Gift.Name: Flower Gift
Flower Gift.Effect: While Sunny Weather is active, Increase 2 Points to the Strength and Sp.Defense Attribute of the User and its allies in range.
Flower Gift.Description: This Pokemon's petals radiate full of energy when the sun shines bright. The energy irradiated makes those around feel stronger.
Flower Gift.EffectIT: Col tempo Soleggiato, la Strength e l'Insight suoi e degli alleati a portata aumentano di 2.

Flower Veil.Name: Flower Veil
Flower Veil.Effect: User and allies in range can't have their Attributes/Traits reduced. User and allies in range can't have any Status Ailment inflicted on them. Previously inflicted or self-inflicted Attribute reductions and/or ailments remain.
Flower Veil.Description: This Pokemon makes flowers grow in gardens and near other Pokemon to protect them from harm.
Flower Veil.EffectIT: Lui e gli alleati a portata non possono avere attributi ridotti né subire problemi di stato. Quelli già presenti o autoinflitti restano.

Fluffy.Name: Fluffy
Fluffy.Effect: Reduce by 2 the Damage dealt to this Pokemon by All Physical Moves. Increase by 2 the Damage dealt to this Pokemon by Fire-Type Moves.
Fluffy.Description: This Pokemon's fur is so fluffy you could die. So soft and snuggly that it invites you to hug it. Hand-wash only, tumble dry with no heat, do not iron.
Fluffy.EffectIT: Le mosse fisiche gli infliggono 2 danni in meno; le mosse Fuoco 2 danni in più.

Forewarn.Name: Forewarn
Forewarn.Effect: In battle, this Pokemon will warn about the strongest move one of its foes has. Storyteller has to reveal it to the trainer of this Pokemon in secret.
Forewarn.Description: When this Pokemon feels bad intentions or disaster approaching, it will mentally warn its trainer. The trainer must make a roll of Insight to get the message.
Forewarn.EffectIT: In battaglia avverte quale sia la mossa più potente di un avversario: il Narratore la rivela in segreto al suo Allenatore.

Generator.Name: Generator
Generator.Effect: This Pokemon and its Allies in Range add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of their Electric-Type Moves.
Generator.EffectIT: Lui e gli alleati a portata ottengono 1 dado extra al Danno delle mosse Elettro.

Gluttony.Name: Gluttony
Gluttony.Effect: This Pokemon can eat any type of food, medicine or herbal medicine with no negative. This pokemon may have up to three berries as held item instead of just one. The berries must not be of the same effect.
Gluttony.Description: This Pokemon eats all day long, it is always carrying food and has no problem to find food sources since it's not a picky eater. It, however, doesn't share.
Gluttony.EffectIT: Può mangiare qualsiasi cibo, medicina o erba senza effetti negativi e può tenere fino a tre bacche (con effetti diversi) invece di una.

Gold Rush.Name: Gold Rush
Gold Rush.Effect: If a foe faints because of a Physical or Special Move used by this Pokemon, at the end of the battle give Money to your Trainer as the Move Pay Day. Outside of battle, it may find precious metals or gems when digging, at Storyteller's discretion.
Gold Rush.EffectIT: Se un avversario va KO per una sua mossa fisica o speciale, a fine battaglia il tuo Allenatore guadagna denaro come con Giornopaga. Fuori dalla lotta, scavando può trovare metalli o gemme preziose (a discrezione del Narratore).

Guiding Song.Name: Guiding Song
Guiding Song.Effect: Sound-Based Moves this Pokemon uses get 1 Extra die to their Damage Pool. This Pokemon is immune to the Damage and Added Effects of Sound-Based Moves.
Guiding Song.EffectIT: Le sue mosse sonore ottengono 1 dado extra al Danno. È immune al danno e agli effetti aggiuntivi delle mosse sonore.

Guts.Name: Guts
Guts.Effect: While affected by a Status Ailment (Burn, Frozen, Paralysis, Poison, Sleep), Increase this Pokemon's Strength Attribute by 2.
Guts.Description: This Pokemon dares to do everything no one else dares to, and won't lose its determination easily, it may be a little reckless, though.
Guts.EffectIT: Se ha un problema di stato (Scottatura, Congelamento, Paralisi, Avvelenamento, Sonno), la sua Strength aumenta di 2.

Harvest.Name: Harvest
Harvest.Effect: If this Pokemon uses a berry as a held item during a fight, the berry will grow back at the end of the battle.
Harvest.Description: This Pokemon will naturally produce edible fruits in a short period of time, if fed with berries it will start growing them too.
Harvest.EffectIT: Se usa una bacca tenuta durante uno scontro, la bacca ricresce a fine battaglia.

Honey Gather.Name: Honey Gather
Honey Gather.Effect: A small barrel of honey can be sold for up to $100. Honey attracts wild Pokemon and feeding a Pokemon with it will make it happy.
Honey Gather.Description: The Pokemon produces its own honey, you can get a small barrel of high quality honey every day.
Honey Gather.EffectIT: Produce miele: un barattolo si vende fino a 100 $. Il miele attira i Pokémon selvatici e rende felice chi lo mangia.

Hustle.Name: Hustle
Hustle.Effect: This Pokemon gets an Extra Low Accuracy 1 and adds 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool for all its Physical Moves.
Hustle.Description: The Pokemon will perform everything in a hurry, it keeps itself busy, but it can be kind of sloppy when it rushes something out.
Hustle.EffectIT: Tutte le sue mosse fisiche ottengono 2 dadi extra al Danno ma anche Precisione Ridotta 1 in più.

Ice Body.Name: Ice Body
Ice Body.Effect: If Hail/Snow Weather is active, you may restore 1 HP to this Pokemon at the end of the Round. This Pokemon is immune to damage from Hail weather.
Ice Body.Description: The Pokemon's body is almost frozen, and can cool down enclosed areas in a few minutes. It feels most comfortable when temperatures are below zero.
Ice Body.EffectIT: Con Grandine/Neve attiva può recuperare 1 PS a fine round. È immune al danno della Grandine.

Ice Scales.Name: Ice Scales
Ice Scales.Effect: Reduce by 2 the Damage dealt to this Pokemon by All Special Moves.
Ice Scales.Description: This Pokemon's body is covered by crystal scales made of ice. Always cold to the touch, it easily deflects most projectiles, energy and light on its surface.
Ice Scales.EffectIT: Le mosse speciali gli infliggono 2 danni in meno.

Illuminate.Name: Illuminate
Illuminate.Effect: Increases the chance of random, non-hostile, wild Pokemon encounters. If there were enviromental challenges, or difficulty penalties due to reduced visibility, this Pokemon and it's allies in range are immune to the effects.
Illuminate.Description: The Pokemon naturally produces a soft and warm light through its body. Other Pokemon approach to it curiously when they see this light.
Illuminate.EffectIT: Aumenta gli incontri con Pokémon selvatici non ostili. Lui e gli alleati a portata ignorano le penalità dovute a scarsa visibilità.

Inner Focus.Name: Inner Focus
Inner Focus.Effect: This Pokemon does not Flinch. The Ability Intimidate does not have any effect against this Pokemon. Outside of battle this Pokemon is able to resist intimidation tactics, fear and stress better than others.
Inner Focus.Description: The Pokemon is extremely serious and focused on everything it does. It remains calm and never backs down, even if it's getting severly injured.
Inner Focus.EffectIT: Non subisce Tentennamento e l'abilità Prepotenza non ha effetto su di lui. Fuori dalla lotta resiste meglio a intimidazioni, paura e stress.

Intimidate.Name: Intimidate
Intimidate.Effect: When this Pokemon comes into battle, Reduce by 1 the Strength of All foes in Range. This effect will last for as long as this Pokemon is out. Outside of battle, wild Pokemon will avoid the party if this Pokemon is out.
Intimidate.Description: This Pokemon has an overwhelming presence that inspires both fear and respect from others.
Intimidate.EffectIT: Quando entra in campo, la Strength di tutti gli avversari a portata cala di 1 finché resta in campo. Fuori dalla lotta i Pokémon selvatici evitano il gruppo.

Iron Fist.Name: Iron Fist
Iron Fist.Effect: Add 1 Dice to the Damage Pool of Fist Based moves.
Iron Fist.Description: The hands of this Pokemon are very strong and heavy, when curled into fists they can go through anything.
Iron Fist.EffectIT: Le mosse di pugno (Fist) ottengono 1 dado extra al Danno.

Keen Eye.Name: Keen Eye
Keen Eye.Effect: This Pokemon cannot have successes removed from its Accuracy rolls by Moves, Items or Abilities.
Keen Eye.Description: These Pokemon have an exceptional sight. Locating small or far away objects is a lot easier for them.
Keen Eye.EffectIT: Mosse, strumenti o abilità non possono togliere successi ai suoi tiri di Precisione.

Klutz.Name: Klutz
Klutz.Effect: Held items won't have any effect on this Pokemon. Items that allow the Pokemon to Mega Evolve, use Z-Moves, go Dynamax/Gigantamax or Change type are not affected.
Klutz.Description: This Pokemon does not understand how to use tools correctly, usually using them in unexpected ways.
Klutz.EffectIT: Gli strumenti tenuti non hanno effetto su di lui (esclusi quelli per Megaevoluzione, mosse Z, Dynamax o cambio di tipo).

Leaf Guard.Name: Leaf Guard
Leaf Guard.Effect: While Sunny Weather is active, this Pokemon can't have any Status Ailments or Conditions inflicted. Previously inflicted ailments/conditions remain.
Leaf Guard.Description: The leaves on this Pokemon's body expand with the sun to completely cover and shield it from superficial damage. They may need to be pruned often.
Leaf Guard.EffectIT: Con il tempo Soleggiato attivo non può subire problemi di stato o condizioni. Quelli già subiti restano.

Levitate.Name: Levitate
Levitate.Effect: This Pokemon has immunity to Ground-Type moves and effects active on the battlefield such as Terrains and certain Entry Hazards.
Levitate.Description: The Pokemon floats to move around without ever touching the ground.
Levitate.EffectIT: Immune alle mosse Terra e agli effetti a terra del campo, come Terreni e alcune trappole.

Light Aura.Name: Light Aura
Light Aura.Effect: Reduce by 2 the Damage dealt to this Pokemon by All Special Moves.
Light Aura.EffectIT: Le mosse speciali gli infliggono 2 danni in meno.

Lightning Legs.Name: Lightning Legs
Lightning Legs.Effect: Kicking and jumping Moves (Double Kick, Jump Kick, High Jump Kick, Low Kick, Thunderous Kick, Blaze Kick, Triple Axel, Bounce and similar, at Storyteller's discretion) get 1 Extra Die to their Damage Pool. Add 1 to this Pokemon's Initiative.
Lightning Legs.EffectIT: Le mosse di calcio e di salto (Doppiocalcio, Calcinvolo, Calcobalzo, Colpo Basso, Tuonocalcio, Calciardente, Triplo Axel, Rimbalzo e simili, a discrezione del Narratore) ottengono 1 dado extra al Danno. +1 all'Iniziativa.

Lightning Rod.Name: Lightning Rod
Lightning Rod.Effect: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-Type Damage. If anyone on the field uses a Single-Target Electric-Type Move, it will be redirected towards this Pokemon. The first time this Pokemon is hit by an Electric-Type move, Increase its Special by 1.
Lightning Rod.Description: This Pokemon will attract lightning and electricity to itself to charge its power. Great for preventing power surges. Bad for your electricity bill.
Lightning Rod.EffectIT: Immune al danno Elettro. Le mosse Elettro a bersaglio singolo usate in campo vengono deviate su di lui. La prima volta che ne viene colpito, il suo Special aumenta di 1.

Liquid Ooze.Name: Liquid Ooze
Liquid Ooze.Effect: If this Pokemon is hit by a Move that would asborb it's vital energy (Leech Seed, Mega Drain, Dream Eater, Drain Punch, etc.) it will deal damage to the foe instead of healing
Liquid Ooze.Description: The Pokemon produces a pestilent and toxic ooze within its body. Do not attempt to eat it.
Liquid Ooze.EffectIT: Se viene colpito da una mossa che assorbe energia (Parassiseme, Megassorbimento, Mangiasogni, Assorbipugno…), l'avversario subisce danno invece di curarsi.

Liquid Voice.Name: Liquid Voice
Liquid Voice.Effect: All Sound-Based Moves this Pokemon uses are considered to be Water-Type.
Liquid Voice.Description: Sound waves from its voice turn the moisture in the air into water, seemingly conjuring dew, rain, and even cascades out of a song.
Liquid Voice.EffectIT: Tutte le sue mosse sonore diventano di tipo Acqua.

Magic Bounce.Name: Magic Bounce
Magic Bounce.Effect: All Support Moves used by a foe that target this Pokemon or its side of the field will have their effects redirected into the foe's instead.
Magic Bounce.Description: The Pokemon will use psychic control on its foe to make it indirectly harm itself, making it look like magic.
Magic Bounce.EffectIT: Le mosse di supporto avversarie che bersagliano lui o il suo lato del campo vengono rimandate a chi le ha usate.

Magic Guard.Name: Magic Guard
Magic Guard.Effect: The Pokemon only receives damage from Physical and Special Moves, Ongoing Damage, Confusion status, Pain Split, Destiny Bond, Perish Song & Self-Damaging Moves. Immune to damage from: Abilities, Status Ailments, Entry Hazards, Recoil, Held Items, or Weather. It can still have Status Ailments inflicted.
Magic Guard.Description: The Pokemon is covered by a faint energy that stops any minor harm that comes its way. This gives the pokemon a bit of an ethereal glow in the dark.
Magic Guard.EffectIT: Subisce danno solo da mosse fisiche e speciali, danno continuato, Confusione, Malcomune, Destinobbligato, Ultimocanto e mosse autolesioniste. Immune al danno di abilità, problemi di stato, trappole, contraccolpo, strumenti e tempo atmosferico.

Magician.Name: Magician
Magician.Effect: This Pokemon will steal the Held Item of a foe it just hit with a Physical or Special Move. If it already has a Held Item you may choose to switch it for the one it stole. For information on held Items see p.83.
Magician.Description: This Pokemon excells at performing simple magic tricks that amaze others, such as conjuring and vanishing objects nearby in the blink of an eye.
Magician.EffectIT: Ruba lo strumento tenuto dall'avversario che ha appena colpito con una mossa fisica o speciale; se ne ha già uno può scambiarli.

Magnet Pull.Name: Magnet Pull
Magnet Pull.Effect: Other than the user, all Steel-Type Pokemon on the field are Blocked.
Magnet Pull.Description: This Pokemon can activate a magnetic field around itself to attract all kinds of metals and disrupt electric devices.
Magnet Pull.EffectIT: I Pokémon Acciaio avversari restano Bloccati finché è in campo. Fuori dalla lotta attira gli oggetti metallici vicini.

Moody.Name: Moody
Moody.Effect: At the end of the Round, reset Attributes modified by Moody, then Reduce a random Attribute by 1 and Increase another random Attribute by 1.
Moody.Description: The Pokemon will have some severe mood swings, and be temperamental most of the time. Hopefully it's just a phase.
Moody.EffectIT: A fine round annulla le modifiche fatte da Lunatico, poi riduce di 1 un attributo a caso e ne aumenta di 1 un altro.

Motor Drive.Name: Motor Drive
Motor Drive.Effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by an Electric-type move, Increase 1 Point to its Dexterity Attribute. This Pokemon doesn't receive damage from Electric-type moves.
Motor Drive.Description: This Pokemon absorbs electricity and stores it as energy to run faster or to power up machinery. An electric car's best friend.
Motor Drive.EffectIT: Le mosse Elettro non gli fanno danno. La prima volta che ne viene colpito, la sua Dexterity aumenta di 1.

Moxie.Name: Moxie
Moxie.Effect: If a foe faints because of a Physical or Special Move used by this Pokemon, Increase its Strength Attribute by 1. Up to 3 points can be increased this way.
Moxie.Description: This Pokemon is naturally fierce and will try to get to a position of power by defeating the alphas in the pack.
Moxie.EffectIT: Se un avversario va KO per una sua mossa fisica o speciale, la sua Strength aumenta di 1 (massimo +3).

Multiscale.Name: Multiscale
Multiscale.Effect: While this Pokemon at full health, Reduce by 1 the damage taken by the next Physical or Special Move it receives.
Multiscale.Description: This Pokemon is covered by two layers of hard scales, if one layer is damaged it will be shed and regrown later.
Multiscale.EffectIT: Finché ha i PS al massimo, la prossima mossa fisica o speciale che lo colpisce infligge 1 danno in meno.

Natural Cure.Name: Natural Cure
Natural Cure.Effect: At the end of the Round, if this Pokemon has a Status Ailment or Condition, Roll 3 Chance Dice to heal it.
Natural Cure.Description: This Pokemon's body will generate substances to heal itself. They can be used to create medicine.
Natural Cure.EffectIT: A fine round, se ha un problema di stato o condizione, tira 3 Dadi Probabilità per guarirlo.

No Guard.Name: No Guard
No Guard.Effect: At the start of the Round, you may declare you won't use Shield Moves, Evasion or Clash Maneuvers. If you do, roll all moves of this Pokemon as if they had no Low Accuracy.
No Guard.Description: This Pokemon can focus on attacking perfectly but will be open to the attacks of its foes as it won't focus on anything but its precision.
No Guard.EffectIT: A inizio round può dichiarare che non userà mosse scudo, Schivata o Contrasto: se lo fa, tutte le sue mosse ignorano la Precisione Ridotta.

Oblivious.Name: Oblivious
Oblivious.Effect: This Pokemon is not affected by the Love Status. It is immune to the effects of moves that affect its feelings such as Taunt, Charm, Captivate etc. at Storyteller's discretion.
Oblivious.Description: This Pokemon will rarely have a satisfactory social interaction; too self-absorbed to take hints or cues in any relationship.
Oblivious.EffectIT: Non subisce Infatuazione ed è immune alle mosse che agiscono sui sentimenti, come Provocazione, Fascino o Seduzione (a discrezione del Narratore).

Oracular Eye.Name: Oracular Eye
Oracular Eye.Effect: Add 2 Extra dice to the Damage Pool of all Physical or Special Psychic-Type Moves that this Pokemon performs.
Oracular Eye.EffectIT: Le sue mosse Psico fisiche o speciali ottengono 2 dadi extra al Danno.

Overgrow.Name: Overgrow
Overgrow.Effect: Pain Penalization won't reduce successes from Accuracy or Damage rolls of Grass-Type Moves used by this Pokemon. Grass-Type Moves get 2 Extra dice to their Damage Pool when this Pokemon is at half HP or less.
Overgrow.Description: When this Pokemon is hurt, it will grow huge plants on its body to defend itself, these plants are very strong but wither quickly.
Overgrow.EffectIT: La penalità da dolore non riduce i successi dei tiri di Precisione e Danno delle sue mosse Erba. Con metà PS o meno, le mosse Erba ottengono 2 dadi extra al Danno.

Pickup.Name: Pickup
Pickup.Effect: If this Pokemon was out of its Pokeball, at the end of the scene see what it found for you at Storyteller's discretion. The higher the Rank of this Pokemon the more valuable the items it will find.
Pickup.Description: This Pokemon will often gather objects and keep a small hoard of treasure it may share with you.
Pickup.EffectIT: Se è stato fuori dalla Poké Ball, a fine scena scopri cosa ha trovato (a discrezione del Narratore). Più alto è il suo Rango, più preziosi gli oggetti.

Poison Point.Name: Poison Point
Poison Point.Effect: If this Pokemon is hit by a Non-Ranged Physical Move, Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict Poison on the foe.
Poison Point.Description: The pointy thorns and scales on this Pokemon release a venom that will infect anyone who touches them roughly. Wear gloves when handling them.
Poison Point.EffectIT: Se viene colpito da una mossa fisica non a distanza, tira 3 Dadi Probabilità per Avvelenare l'avversario.

Poison Touch.Name: Poison Touch
Poison Touch.Effect: If this Pokemon hits a foe with a Non-Ranged Physical Move, Roll 2 Chance Dice to Inflict Poison on the foe.
Poison Touch.Description: Venomous substances will ooze through the body of this Pokemon, you'll become very sick if it touches you.
Poison Touch.EffectIT: Se colpisce con una mossa fisica non a distanza, tira 2 Dadi Probabilità per Avvelenare l'avversario.

Prankster.Name: Prankster
Prankster.Effect: All Support Moves used by this Pokemon are considered to have: "Reaction 1" as Added Effect.
Prankster.Description: This Pokemon will always have a mischievous twinkle in its eyes, no one around will be safe from its pranks.
Prankster.EffectIT: Tutte le sue mosse di supporto ottengono l'effetto aggiuntivo «Reazione 1».

Precognition.Name: Precognition
Precognition.Effect: Psychic-Type Moves used by this Pokemon get 1 Extra Die to their Damage Pool. This Pokemon resists Fighting and Psychic-Type Moves as a Psychic-Type would, without gaining its weaknesses.
Precognition.EffectIT: Le sue mosse Psico ottengono 1 dado extra al Danno. Resiste alle mosse Lotta e Psico come un Pokémon Psico, senza prenderne le debolezze.

Pressure.Name: Pressure
Pressure.Effect: When this Pokemon comes out, All foes in Range spend half (rounded up) of their remaining Will Points without gaining any effect for it. This effect does not stack.
Pressure.Description: Being around this Pokemon will be very stressing and demanding, only the bravest dare to face them one-on-one.
Pressure.EffectIT: Quando entra in campo, ogni avversario a portata spende metà (arrotondata per eccesso) dei suoi punti Volontà rimasti senza ottenere nulla. Non cumulabile.

Punk Rock.Name: Punk Rock
Punk Rock.Effect: Sound-Based Moves this Pokemon uses get 1 Extra die to their Damage Pool. Sound-Based Moves used against this Pokemon have their total Damage reduced by 2.
Punk Rock.Description: The Pokemon loves music and loud noises. It is constantly jamming with its air guitar and can easily improvise a music number out of nothing.
Punk Rock.EffectIT: Le sue mosse sonore ottengono 1 dado extra al Danno. Le mosse sonore usate contro di lui infliggono 2 danni in meno.

Quick Feet.Name: Quick Feet
Quick Feet.Effect: While affected by a Status Ailment (Burn, Frozen, Paralysis, Poison, Sleep), Increase this Pokemon's Dexterity Attribute by 2. If inflicted by Paralysis, this Ability prevents its effects.
Quick Feet.Description: Most of the time this Pokemon will seem to be in a hurry. When pressured, it will move faster than normal.
Quick Feet.EffectIT: Se ha un problema di stato, la sua Dexterity aumenta di 2. Se è Paralizzato, ne ignora gli effetti.

Rain Dish.Name: Rain Dish
Rain Dish.Effect: While Rain Weather is active, you may restore 1 HP to this Pokemon at the end of each Round.
Rain Dish.Description: The Pokemon will store rain water for drink and nourishment.
Rain Dish.EffectIT: Col tempo Pioggia attivo può recuperare 1 PS a fine round.

Rattled.Name: Rattled
Rattled.Effect: The first time this Pokemon is hit by a Bug, Dark, or Ghost-Type Move, or if a foe has the Ability "Intimidate", Increase its Dexterity Attribute by 1.
Rattled.Description: When this scaredy Pokemon becomes startled or scared it will make haste to get away from danger.
Rattled.EffectIT: La prima volta che viene colpito da una mossa Coleottero, Buio o Spettro, o se un avversario ha Prepotenza, la sua Dexterity aumenta di 1.

Reckless.Name: Reckless
Reckless.Effect: When this Pokemon performs a Move with Recoil as an Added Effect, Add 2 Extra dice to the Damage Pool of that Move.
Reckless.Description: The Pokemon will often get into risky situations in order to get what it wants. They are prone to risk their lives without thinking of the consequences.
Reckless.EffectIT: Le sue mosse con Contraccolpo ottengono 2 dadi extra al Danno.

Refrigerate.Name: Refrigerate
Refrigerate.Effect: Normal-Type Moves that the Pokemon uses will deal damage as if they were Ice-Type. Affecting STAB, weakness and resistance. Add 1 Extra die to the Damage Pool of Ice moves.
Refrigerate.Description: This Pokemon's body works akin to a freezer, it can freeze things just by touching them.
Refrigerate.EffectIT: Le sue mosse Normale infliggono danno come se fossero Ghiaccio (STAB, debolezze e resistenze comprese). Le mosse Ghiaccio ottengono 1 dado extra al Danno.

Regenerator.Name: Regenerator
Regenerator.Effect: This Pokemon may Heal up to 4 HP or up to 2 HP in case of Lethal Damage on its own every day. The Pokemon must be out of combat to benefit from this effect.
Regenerator.Description: The body of this Pokemon will regenerate from damage really quick, wounds that would take days to heal will get better in a few hours.
Regenerator.EffectIT: Ogni giorno può curarsi da solo fino a 4 PS (o 2 PS di danno Letale), purché sia fuori dal combattimento.

Rock Head.Name: Rock Head
Rock Head.Effect: This Pokemon will not receive damage from Recoil.
Rock Head.Description: The head and body of the Pokemon are so resistant that they barely feel anything. Careful as they bump into things without even noticing.

Rough Skin.Name: Rough Skin
Rough Skin.Effect: If this Pokemon is hit with a Non-Ranged Physical Move choose one: - Deal 1 Neutral Damage against the attacker. - Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the attacker.
